import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    e = np.exp(-0.6*t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*t**2
            + A*(p[3] + p[4]*t)
            + A**2*(p[5] + p[6]*t)
            + p[7]*A**3 + p[8]*A**2*e + p[9]*e)
